about: Capri Global Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides financial services in India. It offers home loans; micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSME) loans; construction finance; small business loans; loans against property; and gold loans, as well as indirect lending, car loan distribution, and insurance distribution services.
